newsitem.title: USA: Res-Care files for 3.0 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Res-Care files for 3.0 mln shr offering.

text.p: Res-Care Inc said on Wednesday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 3.0 million common shares.
Of the shares being offered, 1,500,000 are being offered by the company, with the balance being offered by certain selling shareholders, Res-Care said.
Res-Care, a provider of residential and support services to the disabled and troubled youth, said will also grant the underwriters an over-allotment option for an additional 450,000 shares.
J.C. Bradford & Co, Montgomery Securities and Equitable Securities Corp will manage the offering, Res-Care said.
The company's proceeds from the offering are intended to be used to repay indebtedness under its revolving credit facility, the company said.
